approvalText: We're looking really good now - I'd like to roll all these changes out to the rest of the troubles pages.
scope: The recommended Brassica composition and rollout of its image wrapping, enlarged diagnostic proportions, natural trailing space, importance-based ordering with bounded page-fit adjustments, separated pale feature panels and top-right ribbon styling. Does not approve unrendered guide compositions, proposed additional stars, final pagination or supplier output.
followup: John requested a disease/pest distinction and research into further stars before rebuilding. The 25-entry shortlist and proposed Common Problem label are recorded in the resource library; no new stars saved by that research pass.
